_comment: Optional shared design tokens for the portal. Edit or replace. Claude Code reads these when implementing portal UI; if absent it follows docs/11-UI-DEVELOPMENT.md + the frontend-design skill. Profit-positive=success, loss-negative=danger; never encode profit/loss by color alone. textMuted is the muted body-TEXT role and must meet WCAG AA (4.5:1) on the slate surfaces — slate-500 (#64748b) only reaches ~4.34:1, so textMuted is slate-600 (#475569). border is the separate non-text role (3:1 bar).
